# Invalid invocations fail with the usage or unsupported-negation message.
! testscript noargs
stdout 'usage: mv src\.\.\. dst'
! testscript onearg
stdout 'usage: mv src\.\.\. dst'
! testscript negation
stdout 'unsupported: ! mv'

# Multiple sources require an existing destination directory.
! testscript missing
stdout 'mv: destination .*missing is not a directory'
unquote file/script.txt
! testscript file
stdout 'mv: destination .*destination.txt is not a directory'

# A missing source still causes the script to fail.
! testscript source
stdout 'FAIL: .*rename .*missing.txt'

-- noargs/script.txt --
mv
-- onearg/script.txt --
mv one.txt
-- negation/script.txt --
! mv one.txt two.txt
-- missing/script.txt --
mv one.txt two.txt missing
-- file/script.txt --
>mv one.txt two.txt destination.txt
>-- destination.txt --
>destination
-- source/script.txt --
mkdir dst
mv missing.txt dst
